name: filecanvas
description: 先在画布中整理，再预览真实路径的 Windows 文件整理工具
author: FileCanvas

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node 04_构建脚本/build-electron.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint 01_源码 02_测试 04_构建脚本 eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 01_源码 02_测试 04_构建脚本 vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node 04_构建脚本/run-desktop-tests.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/electron.e2e.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write 01_源码 02_测试 04_构建脚本 vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json README.md 05_项目文档
scripts.test:demo: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/demo.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:ai: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/canvas-ai.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:expanded: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/expanded-flow.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:smart: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/smart-organize.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:tutorial: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/tutorial.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:settings: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/settings.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:views: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/views.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:simple: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/simple-ui.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:maturity: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/maturity.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:sets: npm run build && node 02_测试/交互测试/file-sets.e2e.mjs
scripts.preview:simple: npm run build && node 04_构建脚本/preview-simple-ui.mjs
